title: Digital Footprint Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Calculate your digital footprint risk score. Assess how exposed your personal data is online.
description: Estimate your digital footprint exposure risk based on your online habits.

inputs.label: Number of social media accounts
inputs.helpText: Count all active social media profiles

outputFields.label: Risk Score
outputFields.description: Your overall digital footprint risk (lower is better)

formula: const pwScore = {never: 0, rarely: 20, sometimes: 50, always: 80}; const socialRisk = Math.min(inputs.socialAccounts * 8, 40); const pwRisk = pwScore[inputs.passwordReuse] || 50; const vpnProtection = inputs.vpnUsage * 0.2; const brokerBonus = inputs.dataBrokerOptOut ? 15 : 0; const score = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(socialRisk + pwRisk - vpnProtection - brokerBonus))); const level = score >= 70 ? 'High Risk' : score >= 40 ? 'Moderate Risk' : 'Low Risk'; const points = Math.round(score * 50); return { riskScore: score, riskLevel: level, dataPoints: points };

educational.methodology: This calculator estimates risk based on online accounts, password hygiene, VPN usage, and data broker opt-out status.
tips: Reduce social media accounts to minimize data exposure
Use a password manager to eliminate password reuse
Use a VPN on public Wi-Fi networks
Regularly opt out of data broker sites
